Description: Prep 20 min · Cook 8 min · Easy · 1 portion — 12-inch thin crust on 24-hour dough, tomato sauce, fior di latte and torn basil.
Method: Stretch a 280 g dough ball to 12 inch | Spread the sauce leaving a 1 cm rim | Tear over the mozzarella | Bake at 280°C for 8 min | Finish with basil, olive oil and oregano

Description: Prep 15 min · Cook 12 min · Medium · 1 portion — penne in parmesan cream, finished with butter-toasted garlic and parsley.
Method: Boil the penne 11 min in salted water | Toast the garlic in butter without colour | Loosen the alfredo sauce with a little pasta water | Toss the drained penne through the sauce | Finish with cream, parmesan and parsley

Description: Prep 18 min · Cook 10 min · Easy · 1 portion — brioche bun, sealed chicken patty, melted cheese and house burger sauce.
Method: Griddle the patty 4 min a side to a 74°C core | Melt the cheese slice over the patty | Toast the cut bun in butter | Spread burger sauce on both halves | Build with lettuce, tomato and onion then close

Description: Prep 10 min · Cook 7 min · Easy · 1 portion — demi baguette split and baked with garlic butter and mozzarella.
Method: Split the baguette lengthways | Spread garlic butter right to the edges | Scatter over the mozzarella | Bake at 220°C for 7 min until blistered | Cut into six fingers and finish with parsley

Description: Prep 25 min · Cook 11 min · Medium · 1 portion — dark chocolate fondant with a molten centre, baked to order.
Method: Melt the dark chocolate and butter together | Whisk the egg, sugar and vanilla to a ribbon | Fold in the flour and cocoa | Fill a buttered ring two-thirds and chill 20 min | Bake at 200°C for 11 min and turn out immediately
